title: Add support for xAI's Grok 3 Mini reasoning effort
body:
### Description

xAI's Grok 3 Mini now supports a reasoning effort param:
https://docs.x.ai/docs/guides/reasoning#reasoning

linked_prs.title: feat(providers/xai): add reasoningEffort option

## Background

## Summary

Introduced the reasoningEffort param to openai-compatible so the xAI provider can use it.

Yes.  
The issue concerns supporting a new parameter ("reasoning effort") for an LLM provider (xAI's Grok 3 Mini), which falls under "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy. This directly relates to agent-specific LLM integration.
